text: GOOOOOALLLL! Brentford back in it and it is 2-1.
GOOOOOALLLL! Fofana makes no mistake this time, and it is 2-0 to Burnley.
GOOOOOALLLL! Bruun Larsen stays calm and finds the left corner from the penalty spot.
CHANCE! Brentford's first decent chance as Jensen sends in a set piece from the right, which finds Toney, but the striker can only send his header wide from 15 yards.
HUGE MISS! Shocker of a miss that from Fofana and it comes just a week after his brilliant strike against West Ham.
MASSIVE MOMENT! GOAL RULED OUT! A high ball comes sailing into the back post from Baptiste.
BIG CHANCE! Brentford this time with a massive chance.
SAVE! Burnley at it again! Taylor plays a lovely ball into the box from the left off a free-kick and tries to find a red shirt.
